protocol.name: polo_shell_ui_v1

description.summary: Polo's GTK helper

protocol.description:
polo-shell-ui draws the GTK chrome Marco drew in its own process: the Alt-Tab popup, the window menu, OSDs and dialogs, and it resolves GTK theme colours for the theme engine. Polo decides what is shown and where; polo-shell-ui only draws it and reports what the user chose.
The global is offered only to the polo-shell-ui process Polo started over its own socket pair. Surfaces are zwlr_layer_shell_v1 overlays; positions are logical coordinates relative to the given output.

entry.name: invalid_color_table
entry.summary: the colour table has the wrong size

entry.name: invalid_icon
entry.summary: icon sizes do not match the pixels sent

description.summary: Marco's MetaTabEntry flags

event.name: switcher_entry

description.summary: one entry of the next show_switcher

event.description: Sent for each entry, in order, before show_switcher.

event.name: switcher_thumbnail

description.summary: a window picture for an entry

event.description: Sent after the entry's switcher_entry, before show_switcher, when compositing-fast-alt-tab is off: width × height pixels, Cairo ARGB32 (premultiplied, native endian), stride width × 4, already scaled as Marco's get_window_surface scales it. The entry's icon goes in its bottom right corner.

event.name: switcher_icon_name

description.summary: a stock icon an entry's window asked for

event.description: Sent after the entry's switcher_entry. Use it if the theme has it.

event.name: switcher_icon_pixels

description.summary: pixels an entry's window asked for

event.description: Sent after the entry's switcher_entry: size × size pixels, Cairo ARGB32, stride size × 4. Used when no stock icon of the entry's applies.

event.name: show_switcher

description.summary: show the entries sent since the last show_switcher

event.description: meta_ui_tab_popup_new () and _set_showing (): centred on the output's work area, with columns (alt-tab-max-columns), expand_to_fit (alt-tab-expand-to-fit-title) and icon_size (icon-size). A new show_switcher replaces the popup.

event.name: workspace_switcher_entry

description.summary: one cell of the workspace popup's grid

event.description: Sent in grid order before show_workspace_switcher, and again before update_workspace_switcher, when it empties the cell's windows. A blank cell has id 0.

description.summary: a window to draw in a cell, bottom to top

event.name: show_workspace_switcher

description.summary: meta_screen_ensure_workspace_popup ()

event.description: The switcher popup with the workspace grid; hide_switcher hides it and switcher_select reports presses on a cell.

request.name: switcher_select

description.summary: meta_ui_tab_popup_mouse_press ()

request.description: Button 1 went down, or moved while down, on an entry. Polo answers with update_selected.

description.summary: Marco's MetaMenuOp
a workspace name for the next show_window_menu

event.name: show_window_menu

description.summary: meta_window_menu_new () and _popup ()

event.description: ops and insensitive are as in Marco; active_workspace is 0xffffffff for a window on all workspaces. The menu answers with exactly one menu_action, with op none when it closes without a choice.

arg.name: time
arg.summary: input time in ms: GTK's activate time for the popup

event.name: hide_window_menu

description.summary: close the menu without an action

event.description: The menu still answers with menu_action op none.

description.summary: the MetaWindowMenuFunc callback

arg.name: icon
arg.summary: icon theme names, comma-separated: the first one found

entry.name: display_confirmation
entry.summary: mate-settings-daemon's "Does the display look OK?"; payload: the seconds left

event.name: show_dialog

description.summary: show a dialog

event.description: payload is the kind's text: the window title, the workspace name, and so on. The dialog answers with exactly one dialog_response.

event.name: hide_dialog

description.summary: close a dialog that no longer applies

event.description: The dialog still answers, with response -1.

request.name: dialog_surface

description.summary: the toplevel that shows a dialog

request.description: Sent before the dialog's toplevel is first committed, so Polo can make it transient for the window it is about, as zenity's WINDOWID does under Marco.

request.name: color_table

description.summary: the GTK colours Marco's theme engine reads

request.description: gtk:fg, bg, light, dark, mid, text, base and text_aa for the five GtkStateType states, in that order (component-major): 40 RGBA colours as 160 native-endian floats. Sent at bind and whenever the GTK theme changes.

event.name: lookup_color

description.summary: look up a GTK theme colour

event.description: Resolves the GTK @define-color used by Marco's gtk:custom(name, fallback). The client replies once with custom_color.

request.name: custom_color

description.summary: reply to lookup_color

request.description: rgba is empty when the GTK theme does not define name; otherwise it contains one RGBA colour as four native-endian floats.

event.name: lookup_icon

description.summary: load a window's icons from the icon theme

event.description: The icon theme's name if it has it, else the icon of the desktop file desktop_id, as Marco's load_window_icon_from_desktop_id () loads it; with neither and fallback set, Marco's default window icon (preferences-desktop-theme, else image-missing). Each comes at mini_size and at size, in logical pixels at scale. The client replies once with icon or no_icon.

request.name: icon

description.summary: reply to lookup_icon

request.description: pixels holds the mini icon, then the icon, each Cairo ARGB32 with stride width × 4. Sizes are in pixels.

description.summary: reply to lookup_icon: nothing found
icons looked up so far may have changed

event.name: switcher_heading

description.summary: a heading for the next show_switcher

event.description: Sent before show_switcher, for that popup only: a line of text above its entries.
